name: University of Tartu
summary: Tartu research university with three English-taught first-level degrees: business administration, science and technology, and a 6-year medicine.

ib.text: Needs the IB Diploma awarded (course results alone do not qualify); an English-taught Diploma meets the English rule. Apply in your final year with current grades. Each degree adds its own test.

programmes.name: Business Administration
programmes.about: Covers economics, finance, marketing and management alongside technical skills, with an entrepreneurial approach and a startup community. Taught in Tartu at the Delta Centre.
programmes.selectionNote: Motivation letter 60% and an online maths test 40%; you need 66 of 100 combined. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Science and Technology
programmes.about: A broad base in natural and technological sciences; you choose genetics and biotechnology, bioengineering and robotics, or chemistry and materials science in the second year.
programmes.ib: Maths plus one of Biology, Chemistry or Physics are scored; a maths-based entry test and an interview follow.

needs.note: Your maths result counts for 20% of the score.
Your best of the three counts for 20% of the score.

programmes.selectionNote: Five parts at 20% each: maths result, best science result, motivation letter, maths test, interview. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Medicine
programmes.about: Integrated bachelor's and master's studies in English at Tartu University Hospital, working with patients; you also learn Estonian to work in local hospitals.
programmes.ib: An online physics and chemistry entrance exam weighs most; motivation letter and interview must each pass 51 of 100.
programmes.selectionNote: Entrance exam in physics and chemistry 60%, motivation letter 20%, interview 20%. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

notes: Only a diploma marked 'IB Diploma Awarded' qualifies; 'IB DP Course awarded' or 'Course Results' does not.
From 2026/27 the university stopped offering tuition waivers to new students from outside the EU/EEA; each programme page states its fee.
The 2027 dates and requirements are due on the programme pages by the end of December; apply early once they open.
